BREAKING | Widespread internet disruption reported across North Korea.

More than 40 websites, including KCNA, Rodong Sinmun and government portals, have experienced significant outages.

Network monitors also detected disruptions to Pyongyang’s internet infrastructure.

ALERT | North Korea says newly deployed firepower units have taken up firing positions along its border with South Korea.
